items.english: It's all very well to set her mind at rest, but even in front of Mother, though nobody really believes a word of it anyway, to come out with such hollow things... it's embarrassing, for us! No ordinary hollowness, but something wildly off the scale, like a dream, something outrageous...
What I said, I don't know, I've forgotten! But I've told no lies—

You don't know the words that make a listener feel solemn. When it comes to saying something to comfort other people, you come out with something wildly grand— but well, anything is better, I suppose, than grumbling and sulking!
notes: Kept ruby reading of 他人 as 'other people' rather than 'another person'.

items.english: Was she so eloquent whenever they met because they lived in separate houses? Or was it some kind of irony? Taki wondered.
That doesn't matter at all. More to the point, is your work coming along? You seem very hard at it.
notes: 勉強 as his creative work, not school study.

items.english: "About half—" he blurted out, as if with nothing to weigh on him— He had of late been absorbed in the conception of a wholly imaginary story. Once he took up his pen, half or nothing, he thought he could write it off in one burst! at any time. No, writing itself gave him no concern. At times he was even dazzled into oppressiveness by too unbridled imaginings, but to take up his pen and turn it into prose, just as when exchanging words with other people, with clumsy phrasing going the long way round, fell short of his fine inspiration.
notes: Kept fixed slogan 'in one burst!' for 一気呵勢; kept second 他人 as 'other people' per ruby.

items.english: When that's done, will we really go on the trip?

notes: Kept deliberately noncommittal agreement; corrected too late in p32.

items.english: "Go if you like"! It was you who brought it up first, long ago.
So we'll go. I want to go.

data.say: Drafted p23 to p32 keeping the wife brisk, Taki evasively agreeable, and in one burst fixed.
